sentences: Vertex expansion measures how many distinct outside neighbors a small vertex set has.
The source asks for explicit regular graphs whose small-set expansion approaches \(d- 2\) at degree d.
The target concerns neighbor diversity rather than only the number of crossing edges, so ordinary spectral quality may not directly yield the requested sharp bound.
Such graphs would strengthen constructive tools where small sets must spread information to many new vertices.
The saved question does not preserve the permitted set-size range or approximation slack, so those parameters must be recovered before comparing a graph family with the target.
